issues.body: Sections 3.1 and 9 still state that the ACIR runaway-unroll and diagnostic findings were captured in a filed self-improvement issue, yet identify it only with the author-defined marker `noir-acir-unroll-2026-07-28`. This is materially unchanged from round 5: a search phrase is not the tracker's durable identifier and does not make the claimed filing reliably auditable from the research record.
issues.fix_hint: Add the actual issue number or URL to both the Section 3.1 disposition and the Section 9 status entry. If the issue was not filed, file the scoped issue first and then cite its resulting durable identifier; do not describe it as filed until that identifier exists.
issues.title: Filed ACIR follow-up still lacks its durable issue identifier

verdict.summary: Round 6 is stagnant. The round-5 major auditability defect remains: Sections 3.1 and 9 claim that a self-improvement issue was filed, but provide only the custom search/dedupe marker `noir-acir-unroll-2026-07-28`, not the issue number or URL. The document therefore still does not supply durable, directly auditable evidence for the claimed disposition.
